figurative_meaning_en: To become a dependent burden on someone, like clinging to their neck
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিধবা বোনটি গলায় এসে পড়েছে, এখন তার দেখাশোনা আমাদের দায়িত্ব।
অলস ছেলেটি পরিবারের গলায় পড়ে আছে, কোনো কাজ করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: The widowed sister has fallen on our neck; now taking care of her is our responsibility.
The lazy boy has become a burden on the family, doing no work at all.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali family dynamics where dependents are seen as a literal 'weight' on the neck.
